facts.title: Linked Pass
facts.text: Increased 12%; source does not specify a unit.

facts.title: NEL Isagi–Hiori
facts.text: Hiori uses Hard Freeze Counter-Attack on NEL Isagi; after the cutscene, use highlighted Direct Shot before the window ends.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: NEL Rin and Hiori balance
history.text: Rin Annihilate speed and power +5%; Hiori Cold Logic Turn became a full dribble, Link Pass range 95m and Below Zero Pass range +20% to 130m.

history.title: NEL Isagi–Hiori chemistry
history.text: Hiori's Hard Freeze Counter-Attack to NEL Isagi highlights Direct Shot after the cutscene; using it triggers chemistry.

history.title: Ice flow rework
history.text: New Ice VFX and revised bonuses: 7% speed; pass receivers get 15% flow and a short speed boost; small auto-track.

history.title: NEL Hiori rework
history.text: NEL Hiori received a revised kit; chemistry with NEL Isagi was described and released June 7. Heel Flick returned to Magical Turn.

history.title: Hiori and showroom refresh
history.text: Hiori refresh, new lobby and showroom NPC.

history.title: Ego's Summer Strike
history.text: Limited 4v4 tournament with strike system and goalkeeper locked. Earlier Hiori–NEL Isagi chemistry announced.

history.title: Yukimiya and Hiori release
history.text: Yukimiya and Hiori styles and flows announced.
